g.text: TFT RESET pull-up and LED only (D020)

g.title: U1
g.text: 5 V logic. Powered by laptop micro-USB.
A1 (BUTTON_ADC): button ladder not documented yet.

g.title: BUS_5V
g.text: Fed from the Leonardo 5V pin (laptop USB).

g.title: RAIL_3V3_TOF
g.text: LM2596 set to 3.3 V, before the

g.title: J7
g.text: ST DB4629, figures 4 and 5. 3.3 V from +3V3_TOF (D021).
No regulator, no level shifter: 3.6 V abs max
XSHUT driven open-drain by the Leonardo (D020).
On board, to VDD: 10 kOhm pull-ups on XSHUT and GPIO1,
2.2 kOhm I2C pull-ups: R1 to SDA via SB1/SB2,
R2 to SCL via SB3/SB4. Photo 2026-11-22: 0 Ohm
links fitted at SB1 and SB3, so both connected.

g.title: R10_R17
g.text: Per line: 1 kOhm in series (R10, R12, R14, R16),
2 kOhm from out to GND (R11, R13, R15, R17).
Out = 2/3 of in: 3.33 V at 5.0 V, 2.8 V at the
ILI9341 V1.09 section 18: VIH 0.7 VDDI to VDDI,
abs max VDDI + 0.3 V. 1.7 mA per line when high.

g.title: J9
g.text: 2.8 in SPI TFT, ILI9341, touch version (MSP2807)
J1 is open (checked 2026-11-21): VCC on 5 V from the
Leonardo 5V pin, through the module's own 3.3 V regulator.
Never bridge J1 while VCC is on 5 V.
Logic 3.3 V (LCDwiki): CS, DC, SDI and SCK through R10-R17.
LED drives the backlight transistor: on 3.3 V = always on.
SDO/MISO not connected. Touch pins 10-14 (separate touch SPI,
XPT2046 on the module): touch not used, not connected.

g.title: J12
g.text: Phase A pulled up to 5 V by the Leonardo's
Phase B and Z not used: insulate.

g.title: J13
g.text: Phase B and Z not used: insulate.
